eligibility: NGG and at most one ungapped mismatch at p1-p8
training_outcome: log2 predicted replicate geometric-mean off-target ChIP height (nCPM)

feature_definitions.E12: PAM-proximal p1-p12 score from E12_primary/score_sites.py and algorithm_parameters.tsv
feature_definitions.GC250: Fraction G+C among callable bases in the two 250-bp flanks excluding the central 23-mer
feature_definitions.post1_G: 1 for G on the guide-like strand immediately after NGG, otherwise 0
